description: This file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionManager class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.search package. It utilizes the Akka actor system and tests various aspects of subscription request handling, cancellation, and concurrency scenarios.

classes.name: SubscriptionManagerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SubscriptionManager, testing various subscription behaviors and edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system, materializer, and test probes before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: noSuchSubscription
methods.description: Tests behavior when requesting a non-existent subscription.

methods.name: illegalPageSize
methods.description: Tests behavior when creating a subscription with an invalid page size.

methods.name: illegalDemand
methods.description: Tests behavior when requesting data with invalid demand (zero).

methods.name: parallelSessions
methods.description: Tests handling multiple concurrent subscriptions, including success, cancellation, and errors.

methods.name: subscriptionComplete
methods.description: Helper to create a SubscriptionComplete message for a given subscription ID.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Helper to generate a SubscriptionHasNextPage message with given subscription ID and thing ID.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Helper to create a RequestFromSubscription message.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Extracts a tag index from a StreamThings filter string for test purposes.

methods.name: createSubscription
methods.description: Creates a CreateSubscription message with sample parameters for testing.

methods.name: createSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Initializes an ActorRef for SubscriptionManager without retries, used for testing upstream failures.
